    • chunkLongConnectorChains

      private static String chunkLongConnectorChains(String s, String connectorKw, LanguageFormatter.RenderMode mode, String language, boolean isAnd)
      Chunk long flat connector chains into lists for readability. Trigger only for 7..25 items to avoid surprising rewrites and to avoid interfering with the 3..6 comma-list smoothing from Commit 2. HTML mode: "All of the following hold:
      • ...
        • ...
      " TEXT mode: "All of the following hold: (1) ... (2) ... (3) ..."

    • splitLeadingQuantifierHeader

      private static NLGReadability.QuantifierSplit splitLeadingQuantifierHeader(String s, String andKw)
      If s begins with a quantifier header ("for all"/"there exists"), split it into: - prefix: the quantifier + declared variables + trailing space - body: the remainder This is conservative and English-surface based. It is designed to work with Sigma’s template patterns such as: "for all VAR and VAR BODY..." It relies on annotated vars being protected as placeholders (e.g., §T0§), so we can safely identify the variable list as placeholders separated by "and".

    • factorSharedPrefix

      private static String factorSharedPrefix(List<String> items, String connectorKw)
      Attempt to factor a shared prefix across a list of clauses, producing one concise clause. Example (AND): ["Jane is mother of Bill", "Jane is mother of Bob", "Jane is mother of Sue"] -> "Jane is mother of Bill, Bob, and Sue" Example (OR): ["X is parent of A", "X is parent of B", "X is parent of C"] -> "X is parent of A, B, or C" Returns null if not safely applicable.

    • rewriteBySegments

      private static String rewriteBySegments(String s, String andKw, String orKw, LanguageFormatter.RenderMode mode, String language)
      Apply readability improvements only inside "safe" segments of text. Safe segment definition (conservative): - not inside a negation block "~{ ... }" - not inside balanced (), [], or {} blocks We scan left-to-right, copy blocked spans unchanged, and run the existing readability pipeline on safe spans.

    • applyReadabilityToSafeSegment

      private static String applyReadabilityToSafeSegment(String segment, String andKw, String orKw, LanguageFormatter.RenderMode mode, String language)
      Apply existing readability rules to a safe segment only. This reuses your already-tested methods: - smoothSimpleConnectorChains - chunkLongConnectorChains We do NOT attempt quantified-list rendering here; that remains a whole-body rule.

    • rewriteUsingSegMarkers

      private static String rewriteUsingSegMarkers(String s, String andKw, String orKw, LanguageFormatter.RenderMode mode, String language)
      Marker-aware rewriting: - Walk the string and detect runs of the form: [SEG]A[/SEG] [SEG]B[/SEG] [SEG]C[/SEG] ... - Apply Commit 6 factoring across the run (using the connector kw). - Also apply existing per-segment readability rules inside each [SEG]...[/SEG]. We preserve markers in the output (they will be stripped later).

    • rewriteNode

      private static NLGReadability.Node rewriteNode(NLGReadability.Node n, String andKw, String orKw, LanguageFormatter.RenderMode mode, String language, Map<String,String> placeholderToOriginal, Map<String,String> symToTypeCtx)
      Recursively normalizes the logical AST prior to rendering.

      This method performs a tree-to-tree rewrite that prepares nodes for final textual or HTML rendering. It does not perform rendering itself.

      Responsibilities:

      • Clean and normalize NLGReadability.AtomNode text by removing segmentation markers and applying conservative, local readability rewrites.
      • Ensure that AND/OR structure is represented only by NLGReadability.AndNode and NLGReadability.OrNode, not embedded inside atom text.
      • Recursively rebuild the tree so all child nodes satisfy the same invariants.
      • Reattach parent pointers to preserve tree integrity.

      After this pass, all NLGReadability.AtomNode instances contain presentation-ready, marker-free text, allowing renderText() and renderHTML() to focus solely on high-level rhetorical realization.

    • stripSegMarkersConservatively

      private static String stripSegMarkersConservatively(String s, String andKw, String orKw)
      Normalization-only: remove [SEG]...[/SEG] markers while preserving the inner text. This method intentionally does NOT: - smooth connector chains - chunk lists - factor shared prefixes It is conservative: if any [SEG] lacks a matching closing marker, it returns the original input unchanged to avoid corrupting the template.

    • isRedundantInstanceOf

      private static boolean isRedundantInstanceOf(NLGReadability.AtomNode atom, Map<String,String> placeholderToOriginal, Map<String,String> symToTypeCtx)
      Returns true iff this AtomNode is a redundant type constraint of the form: X is an instance of Organism and X is already typed as Organism in the current quantifier context. AtomNode.text is placeholderized at rewrite time (e.g., "§T3§ is an §T4§ of §T5§").
